EN: ♪ We are baddies, yes that's true ♪\n♪ Sing our song and we'll kill you! ♪
ZH: ♪ 我们是坏蛋，一点没错 ♪\n♪ 唱起我们的歌，我们会杀了你！♪

EN: ♪ I don't even know your song ♪ Can't we all just get along? ♪
ZH: ♪ 我压根不知道你们的歌 ♪ 我们就不能好好相处吗？♪

EN: ♪ Lovely jacket, where'd you get it? ♪ Was it from a homeless guy? ♪
ZH: ♪ 夹克真漂亮，哪弄来的？ ♪ 是从流浪汉那儿弄来的吗？♪

EN: ♪ Sinners will try to circumvent ♪\n♪ But in the end they all repent! ♪
ZH: ♪ 罪人们总想绕道而行 ♪\n♪ 但到头来全都得忏悔！♪

EN: ♪ To Atom you will represent ♪\n♪ Say hi to Him on your ascent! ♪
ZH: ♪ 你终将在原子面前现身 ♪\n♪ 升天之时，替我向他问好！♪

EN: ♪ Repent! Repent! ♪\n♪ Don't be a malcontent! ♪
ZH: ♪ 忏悔！忏悔！ ♪\n♪ 别再心怀不满！♪

EN: ♪ Atom's Love you can't prevent ♪\n♪ So don't lament, repent! ♪
ZH: ♪ 原子的爱，你无法阻止 ♪\n♪ 所以别哀叹，快忏悔！♪

EN: ♪ Relent! Consent ♪\n♪ To let his glow cement ♪
ZH: ♪ 松口吧！快同意 ♪\n♪ 让他的光辉在你心中生根！♪

EN: ♪ Your broken soul lost in torment ♪\n♪ Repent! Repent! ♪
ZH: ♪ 你破碎的灵魂在折磨中迷失 ♪\n♪ 忏悔！忏悔！♪

EN: ♪ Even with the best intent ♪ I have no sins to present! ♪
ZH: ♪ 即使怀着最好的初衷 ♪ 我无过可陈！♪

EN: ♪ Okay, let's say that I repent ♪ Just for the sake of argument ♪
ZH: ♪ 好吧，就算我忏悔 ♪ 也只是为了争辩♪

EN: Oops, sorry. Wrong production.
ZH: 哦，抱歉，走错片场了。

EN: ♪ Priva son d'ogni conforto ♪ e pur speme di morire ♪ per me misera non v'è ♪
ZH: ♪ 我已失去一切慰藉 ♪ 却连死的希望 ♪ 对我这苦命人也全无 ♪

EN: Uh... Okay?
ZH: 呃……好的？

EN: ♪ Isn't science wonderful? ♪ Makes us great and powerful! ♪\n♪ Accept no sub-sti-tutes! ♪
ZH: ♪ 科学多么奇妙！♪ 让我们伟大又强大！♪\n♪ 绝不接受替-代-品！♪

EN: ♪ It's okay, we understand ♪ You're but a rube from the Wasteland ♪\n♪ A moron and a brute! ♪
ZH: ♪ 没事，我们理解 ♪ 你不过是废土来的乡巴佬 ♪\n♪ 一个蠢货和一个莽夫！♪

EN: ♪ Don't mind us, we're not there ♪ We're not here nor anywhere ♪\n♪ We're the In-sti-tute! ♪
ZH: ♪ 别介意，我们不在那里 ♪ 我们也不在这里，不在任何地方 ♪\n♪ 我们是学-院！♪

EN: ♪ In secret our plans proceed ♪ Mankind Redefined indeed! ♪\n♪ Fear does not com-pute! ♪
ZH: ♪ 我们的计划在暗中推进 ♪ 人类重塑，千真万确！♪\n♪ 恐惧无法计-算！♪

EN: ♪ Until the science gets done ♪ And a new age has begun ♪\n♪ We'll be re-so-lute! ♪
ZH: ♪ 直到科学完成 ♪ 新时代已然开启 ♪\n♪ 我们将坚-定-不移！♪

EN: ♪ In the meantime we'll lay low ♪ In our hidden base below. ♪\n♪ Hail the In-sti-tute! ♪
ZH: ♪ 同时我们会蛰伏 ♪ 在我们隐蔽的地下基地里。♪\n♪ 向学-院致敬！♪

EN: ♪ How bizarre, I hear talking ♪ And yet I don't see a thing ♪\n♪ Pretty please, don't shoot! ♪
ZH: ♪ 真奇怪，我听到说话声 ♪ 却什么也看不见 ♪\n♪ 求求你们，别开枪！♪

EN: ♪ I'm sorry but I've got orders ♪ If I meet with any posers ♪\n♪ I must e-xe-cute! ♪
ZH: ♪ 抱歉，但我有命令在身 ♪ 若遇上任何冒牌货 ♪\n♪ 我必将处-决他们！♪

EN: ♪ I guess this is a new start ♪ Of our lives you're now part ♪\n♪ Always you'll be in our hearts! ♪
ZH: ♪ 我想这是新的开始 ♪ 你已成为我们生命的一部分 ♪\n♪ 你将永远活在我们心中！♪

EN: ♪ We're sorry it must come to this ♪ Without so much as a kiss ♪\n♪ We send you back to the Abyss! ♪
ZH: ♪ 抱歉竟到了这一步 ♪ 连一个吻都没有 ♪\n♪ 就把你送回深渊！♪

EN: ♪ Look here, my love, another prey ♪\nTo its own doom has found its way ♪
ZH: ♪ 看啊，亲爱的，又一只猎物 ♪\n它已寻路走向自己的末日 ♪

EN: ♪ But wait! Tell me, can this be true? ♪\n♪ That face, those eyes of baby blue? ♪
ZH: ♪ 但等等！告诉我，这是真的吗？♪\n♪ 那张脸，那双婴儿蓝的眼睛？♪

EN: ♪ Our long-lost child has been returned ♪\n♪ To help us make the wasteland burn! ♪
ZH: ♪ 我们失散多年的孩子回来了 ♪\n♪ 来帮我们焚尽这片废土！♪

EN: ♪ Come on, young one, take our hand ♪\n♪ As we spread fear throughout the land! ♪
ZH: ♪ 来吧，孩子，握住我们的手 ♪\n♪ 随我们把恐惧遍布大地！♪

EN: ♪ My parents, I can't believe it! ♪ But to this I can't commit ♪ Maybe I could just visit? ♪
ZH: ♪ 我的父母，我不敢相信！♪ 但我不能与他们相认，♪ 也许我只去拜访一下？♪

EN: ♪ I sought you far and wide ♪ But now your request is denied ♪ The Overseer is my guide! ♪
ZH: ♪ 我四处寻找你们 ♪ 但现在你们的请求已被拒绝 ♪ 监督者才是我的引路人！♪

EN: ♪ How could I have been so wrong? ♪ I really thought I belonged ♪\n♪ In the great, big Wasteland! ♪
ZH: ♪ 我怎么会错得这么离谱？♪ 我真以为自己属于 ♪\n♪ 这片伟大广阔的废土！♪

EN: ♪ I believed meeting my folks ♪ Would be grand, what a joke! ♪\n♪ I want out of this Wasteland! ♪
ZH: ♪ 我曾以为见到我的父母 ♪ 会很美好，真是天大的玩笑！♪\n♪ 我要离开这片废土！♪

EN: ♪ Well I guess it's no one's fault ♪ I just belong in a Vault ♪\n♪ Not outside, in the Wasteland. ♪
ZH: ♪ 我想这不怪任何人 ♪ 我只属于避难所 ♪\n♪ 而不是外面的废土。♪

EN: ♪ So beware what you wish for ♪ As you walk out through the door ♪\n♪ Into the Waa-aasteland! ♪
ZH: ♪ 所以许愿要当心 ♪ 当你走出那扇门 ♪\n♪ 走向废——土！♪

EN: A duet of singing Raiders has been spreading terror in the Wasteland using high production value musical numbers. We need to ring down the curtain on these musical thugs!
ZH: 一对会唱歌的掠夺者用高水准的音乐节目在废土上散播恐怖。我们得让这些音乐暴徒谢幕！

EN: Wasteland: The Musical
ZH: 废土音乐剧

EN: Stop the Singing Raiders.
ZH: 阻止歌唱的掠夺者。

EN: Stop a gang of singing Raiders from terrorizing the area.
ZH: 停止一帮唱歌的掠夺者威胁整个地区。

EN: Tell you what, some Raiders have been hassling us. Take down their leader and we'll tell you. Deal?
ZH: 告诉你，有些掠夺者给我们脸色看了。打倒他们的首领，我们就告诉你。成交吗？

EN: Yeah, we met this Wizard of Water, and we bought his... product.
ZH: 是的，我们遇到了水之术士，我们买了他的……产品。

EN: It was... interesting.
ZH: 这很……有趣。

EN: Interesting? In what way?
ZH: 有趣吗？以什么方式？

EN: Does the “magical” water really work or is it a total sham?  We need to track down this Water Wizard and see if he's the real deal or a snake oil salesman.
ZH: “神奇”水真的有效还是完全假的？我们需要追踪这个水之术士，看看他是不是真正的商人还是卖大力丸的骗子。

EN: Water into Brine
ZH: 水变成盐水

EN: Ask about the Wizard's water at the old Vault-Tec offices.
ZH: 在旧避难所科技办公室询问神奇水。

EN: Talk to the folks at the Vault-Tec offices about the water.
ZH: 和避难所科技办公室的人谈论有关水的事。

EN: You've gotten a lead to a supply of Weapons out in the Wasteland.
ZH: 你在废土上得到了关于武器供应的线索。

EN: Weapons Run
ZH: 武器赛跑

EN: Recover the main stash of Weapons.
ZH: 找回主要的武器存货。

EN: Find more stored Weapons.
ZH: 寻找更多的武器存货。

EN: Find more stored Weapons.
ZH: 寻找更多的武器存货。

EN: Recover the Weapons.
ZH: 找回武器。

EN: Great! Oh by the way, no one else is expecting you here, so you'll probably get shot at. Good luck!
ZH: 真棒！哦顺便，没人等你们来，所以你们很可能一进门就挨枪子儿。祝好运！

EN: No. The bosses ain't thinking straight. Go deal with it.
ZH: 不，这些老大们根本没动脑子！赶紧去处理。

EN: Oh good, someone came! Look, you gotta do something about this wedding!
ZH: 哦好啊，有人来了！看看，你必须得做点什么才行！

EN: Sally an' Marcus are supposed to get married, but there's a problem.
ZH: 萨莉和马克斯本应该结婚的，但出了点问题。

EN: See, I'm good with the murdering and pillaging, not so much with the words.
ZH: 看吧，打打杀杀才是我擅长的，说话什么的根本不行。

EN: Anyway, I told Sally I was sending for a love guru. So can you help them?
ZH: 不管怎么样， 我告诉萨莉我会派一个爱情专家过去。你能帮助他们吗？

EN: I'll certainly try.
ZH: 我会努力的。

EN: Are you sure about this? Shouldn't love just run its course?
ZH: 你确定吗？难道爱情不是天注定的吗？

EN: Yeah, you're right. Marcus, I'm leaving you forever. Goodbye!
ZH: 是啊，你说得对。马克斯，再见，我再也不会回到你身边了！

EN: Is that how it's going to be? Fine, go live with the Vault Dwellers for all I care, Marcus.
ZH: 你真的要这样吗？行啊，去和那些居民们一起生活啊，马克斯！我一点儿也不在乎！

EN: You're right! Honeycakes? Let's run away together!
ZH: 你说的对！蜂蜜蛋糕？我们一起逃跑吧！

EN: Hey! You there! You must be that love guru I've been hearing about.
ZH: 嘿，你在那儿呀。你应该就是传说中的那个爱情专家吧。

EN: Marcus seems to have gotten cold feet about this wedding.
ZH: 马克斯似乎对这场婚礼临阵退缩了。

EN: And I don't know if I can go on being a Raider.
ZH: 而且我不知道我能不能继续当一个掠夺者。

EN: What should we do?
ZH: 我们应该怎么做？

EN: Sally, you're too good for Marcus. Come live with us at the Vault.
ZH: 萨莉，马克斯配不上你。跟我们一起回避难所生活吧。

EN: Marcus, Sally doesn't appreciate you enough.
ZH: 马克斯，萨莉不够珍惜你。

EN: Neither one of you is cut out for Raiding anymore. Why not give it up and elope?
ZH: 你们两个都很久不做掠夺者了。为什么不放弃然后私奔呢？

EN: The notorious Raider, Sally Switchblade, is getting married to the infamous Marcus Hammer. But they're both having second thoughts, because neither wants to live the Raider lifestyle anymore. If only they'd communicate! Bust in and solve their problems for them.
ZH: 臭名昭著的掠夺者“刀锋萨莉”准备和另一个声名狼藉的掠夺者“铁锤马克斯”结婚了。但双方都还有点犹豫，因为他们都不想再作为掠夺者生活了。问题是他们根本不知道该怎么交流！赶紧介入帮他们解决问题吧。

EN: Wedding Crashers
ZH: 婚礼上的不速之客

EN: Stop the wedding.
ZH: 阻止婚礼。

EN: Help an engaged Raider couple work through their problems.
ZH: 帮助掠夺者夫妇解决问题。

EN: Boss ain't gonna like someone busting up her wedding!
ZH: 老大们可不喜欢有人破坏他们的婚礼！

EN: You with the bride, or groom? Need to know which lot to bury you in.
ZH: 你是新郎的熟人还是新娘的熟人？需要知道把你们埋在哪个坑里、

EN: Yeah! Carnage! Now this is a great wedding!
ZH: 耶！大屠杀！现在这个婚姻才像样点！

EN: I forgot to bring a gift. Maybe these guys have some sweet loot I can use...
ZH: 我忘记带礼物了。也许这些家伙身上会有些什么不错的战利品可以让我拿来当礼物……

EN: I've discovered a map leading to Vault 242, where the “Dwellers” were all creatures rather than humans. I should follow the map and unlock the secrets this Vault has to offer.
ZH: 我们已经发现了通往242号避难所的地图，这个避难所里的“居民”不是人类而是各种生物。我该跟着地图然后解开关于这个避难所的秘密。

EN: Welcome to Paradise
ZH: 欢迎来到天堂

EN: Explore Vault 242.
ZH: 探索242号避难所。

EN: Kill the Alpha Deathclaw.
ZH: 消灭领头死爪。

EN: Unlock the secrets of Vault 242.
ZH: 揭开242号避难所的秘密。

EN: Ain't no Jersey here.
ZH: 这里还是没有棒球衫。

EN: Coach is out there. Somewhere. Watching. Taunting. When we find him, we find Rackie Jobinson's Jersey!
ZH: 教练还在外面，某个地方。看着，嘲笑着我们。当我们找到他的时候，我们就能找到罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫了！

EN: We're Batting 1000!
ZH: 击球一千次！

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Now Big Wes wants you to kill a Mole rat brood mother, with one catch. You can only use pistols. Good luck piercing moleskin with those!
ZH: 现在大维斯要你杀掉一只鼹鼠巢母，但有个附加条件：你只能用手枪。祝你能用那些手枪打穿鼹鼠皮吧！

EN: Whack-a-Mole
ZH: 鼹鼠大战

EN: Kill the Mole rat brood mother.
ZH: 消灭鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Kill the Mole rat brood mother.
ZH: 消灭鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Another room, another failure. But we won't give up hope!
ZH: 又一间房，再一次失败。但是我们不会放弃希望！

EN: Thirteen searches, thirteen failures. How unlucky! For the fourteenth attempt, we'll search the ruins of Vault 701.
ZH: 13次搜索，13次失败。太不幸了！第十四次尝试，我们会前往701号避难所废墟。

EN: What's on Second.
ZH: “什么”在二垒？

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: When Irish Eyes are Glowing
ZH: 当爱尔兰的眼睛开始闪光

EN: What? STILL no Jersey?
ZH: 什么？还是没有棒球衫？

EN: Coach wasn't at the Wilson Automatoys factory, but maybe he's getting in a workout in the ruins of Madden's Gym!
ZH: 教练不在威尔逊原子玩具厂，但是也许他在麦登健身房里锻炼！

EN: When Life Throw's You a Curveball...
ZH: 当生活甩给你一个弧形球……

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Said there were some settlers that had been kidnapped by Raiders. They're in Vault 778. Here, take this uniform. I sure won't need it.
ZH: 据说一些定居者被掠夺者绑架了。他们在778号避难所。给，拿着这件制服。我反正用不上了。

EN: Jeez, finally someone found us!
ZH: 天啊，终于有人找到我们了。

EN: You're a lot more effective than that last fellow.
ZH: 你们比上次那个人有效率多了。

EN: He tried to recruit us into the Minutemen or whatever, then took off.
ZH: 他想让我们加入义勇军组织还是什么的，然后就走了。

EN: Did he say where he was going?
ZH: 他有说他去哪里了吗？

EN: A group of settlers is stuck in a Mole rat den. Word is, they have info on Preston Garvey. Go help them out of their jam!
ZH: 一群定居者被困在鼹鼠巢穴里。据说他们有关于普雷斯顿·加维的消息。快去帮他们脱困吧！

EN: When Preston Calls
ZH: 普雷斯顿的呼救

EN: Find the settlers.
ZH: 找到定居者们。

EN: Kill the Mole rat brood mother.
ZH: 消灭鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Get more information to find Preston.
ZH: 找到更多关于普雷斯顿的消息。

EN: Mole rat of course! But I made it look like a turkey.
ZH: 当然是鼹鼠！但我让它看起来像个火鸡。

EN: Sacre bleu! I'd better get back.
ZH: 真是见了鬼！我最好回去。

EN: Uh... that's not cranberry sauce.
ZH: 呃……那不是蔓越莓酱。

EN: Thank goodness you found me.
ZH: 谢天谢地你们找到了我。

EN: One of these Mole rats ran away with my favorite butcher knife.
ZH: 有一只鼹鼠带着我最喜欢的菜刀跑了。

EN: Are you serving turkey or stuffed Mole rat for Thanksgiving?
ZH: 感恩节你端上来的是火鸡，还是填了馅的鼹鼠？

EN: You forgot to make the stuffing.
ZH: 你忘了做火鸡填馅了。

EN: I'm just here for the cranberry sauce.
ZH: 我来这里是为了蔓越莓酱的。

EN: The cook went to go find his butcher knife. Now who will carve the turkey?
ZH: 厨师去找他的菜刀了，现在谁来切这些火鸡？

EN: Who's Carving the Turkey?
ZH: 谁在切火鸡？

EN: Find the cook.
ZH: 找到厨师。

EN: Rescue the cook.
ZH: 拯救厨师。

EN: No Coach. No Jersey. No nothing.
ZH: 没有教练。没有棒球衫。什么都没有。

EN: Henrietta was Coach's old girlfriend. She doesn't know where he is, but gave us a sweet weapon to help take him down. The search goes on!
ZH: 亨丽埃塔是教练的前女友。她不知道他在哪里，但她给了一个很赞的武器来帮助你拿下他。继续寻找吧！

EN: Who's on First?
ZH: 谁是第一个？

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: The search goes on!
ZH: 搜寻仍在继续！

EN: Thank you for rescuing me!
ZH: 谢谢你们救了我！

EN: That Willard Glover guy was out of his mind.
ZH: 那个叫威拉德·格洛弗的人一定是疯了。

EN: He thought the Mole rats were his friends.
ZH: 他以为鼹鼠是他的朋友。

EN: Just when I thought Raiders couldn't get any crazier...
ZH: 就在我以为不可能有人比掠夺者还要疯狂的时候……

EN: I've found a ransom note written by a Raider Boss named Willard Glover. He says he's captured a settler and taken him to the nearby Corvega Factory.
ZH: 我们找到了一条赎金字条，落款是掠夺者头目威拉德·格洛弗。他说他抓了一个定居者，把人带到了附近的可伟佳装配厂。

EN: With Friends Like These
ZH: 另类的朋友

EN: Kill Willard Glover.
ZH: 消灭威拉德·格洛弗。

EN: Rescue the settler.
ZH: 拯救定居者。

EN: Rescue the settler trapped in the Corvega Factory.
ZH: 拯救被困在可伟佳装配厂的定居者。

EN: You killed my furry little friends! How could you!?
ZH: 你杀死了我毛茸茸的小朋友！你好大胆子？！

EN: Ah, hello there! I am Dr. Hurfburg. Do you like my disguise?
ZH: 啊，你好呀！我是霍夫伯格博士。你喜欢我的伪装吗？

EN: I have seen things... Horrors which no man should see.
ZH: 我见识过一些东西……无人见识过的恐怖。

EN: The pincers, and the eggs... Gah!
ZH: 那些钳子，还有卵……呃！

EN: Thank you for saving me!
ZH: 谢谢你们救了我！

EN: Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, researching the mating habits of Radscorpions. Make sure he's not in over his head.
ZH: 著名科学家欧拓凡霍夫伯格就在附近，正在研究辐射蝎的交配习惯，请确保他的安全。

EN: Wonders of Nature
ZH: 自然的奇迹

EN: Find Dr. Hurfburg.
ZH: 寻找霍夫伯格博士。

EN: Kill the Glowing Radscorpion.
ZH: 消灭发光辐射蝎。

EN: Dr. Hurfburg vs. Pincers of Peril!
ZH: 霍夫伯格博士 vs. 危险之钳！

EN: Ah, hello there! I am Dr. Hurfburg. Do you like my disguise?
ZH: 啊，你好呀！我是霍夫伯格博士。你喜欢我的伪装吗？

EN: For years, I have searched for something to prolong life, always without results.
ZH: 这么多年，我都在寻找长寿的方法，但一直一无所获。

EN: But now, I have found the secret!
ZH: 但是现在，我找到了！

EN: Nuka-Cola Quantum!
ZH: 量子核子可乐！

EN: Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, searching for a modern-day Fountain of Youth. Find him, and learn what he's discovered!
ZH: 著名科学家欧拓凡霍夫伯格就在附近，正在研究现代社会永葆青春的方法。找到他，看看他有什么发现。

EN: Wonders of Science
ZH: 科学的奇迹

EN: Find Dr. Hurfburg.
ZH: 寻找霍夫伯格博士。

EN: Kill the Glowing One.
ZH: 消灭发光种。

EN: Dr. Hurfburg is on a Quest for knowledge and adventure!
ZH: 霍夫伯格博士背负着探索知识和冒险的重任！

EN: Ah, hello there! I am Dr. Hurfburg. Do you like my disguise?
ZH: 啊，你好呀！我是霍夫伯格博士。你喜欢我的伪装吗？

EN: This project has been a disaster! The robots do nothing but explode!
ZH: 这个项目简直是个灾难！机器人什么都不做，只知道爆炸！

EN: And all that noise has attracted some very unsavory creatures!
ZH: 这些噪音吸引了一些讨厌的生物！

EN: Here, please take these leftover parts. They're of no use to me!
ZH: 拿着，请带走这些残留的部件吧。它们对我来说已经没用了！

EN: Famed scientist Otto von Hurfburg is nearby, working on a Mr. Handy capable of exploring space. See what he's discovered!
ZH: 著名科学家欧拓凡霍夫伯格就在附近，正在研究可以探索太空的巧手先生，去看看他的进展吧！

EN: Wonders of Technology
ZH: 技术的奇迹

EN: Find Dr. Hurfburg.
ZH: 寻找霍夫伯格博士。

EN: Kill the Alpha Deathclaw.
ZH: 消灭领头死爪。

EN: Dr. Hurfburg is on a Quest for knowledge and adventure!
ZH: 霍夫伯格博士背负着探索知识和冒险的重任！

EN: Right? I thought I'd get shot to death. Not eaten alive. Who knew?
ZH: 世事难料不是么？我本来以为我会被一枪击毙，结果现在要被活生生吃掉了。

EN: Be careful! Overseer Stan is a Glowing One!
ZH: 小心点！监督者斯坦是只发光种！

EN: Extortion? Really? You sure you're not a Raider?
ZH: 勒索？真的吗啊？你确定你不是掠夺者？

EN: You and me both!
ZH: 我俩都是！

EN: Are you part of some Vault exchange program I don't know about?
ZH: 你是不是属于什么我不知道的避难所交换项目？

EN: Now's not a good time...
ZH: 现在不是个好时候……

EN: Rubarb's Raiders came in here, guns blazing. They punctured the reactor!
ZH: 鲁巴布的掠夺者们来到这里，拿枪扫射。他们击穿了反应器！

EN: Now everyone inside is a Feral Ghoul!
ZH: 现在里面的每个人都变成狂尸鬼了！

EN: Well doesn't that just figure.
ZH: 呵，果然不出所料。

EN: Feral Ghouls? Okay, no worries. We'll clean them out!
ZH: 狂尸鬼？好的，别担心。我们可以消灭他们！

EN: Ghoul extermination isn't a problem. For a price...
ZH: 清除尸鬼不是问题。但代价……

EN: You know, I'm starting to think Vault-Tec skimped on internal security.
ZH: 我觉得避难所科技好像在内部保安系统上偷工减料了。

EN: I was a... good human... But being a Glowing One... ain't no picnic!
ZH: 我是一个……好人……但是成为一个发光种……可不是小孩子过家家！
